pathAssistantSteps.info: Confirm the asset metrics and Argus signal support the sell decision before advancing to NDA.

Send an NDA to each interested party. Create one NDA record per party using the NDA lookup to this Disposition. The expanded NDA model - the Declined state, the Pending to Not Sent rename, party roles, counter-signature and the all-signed gate - arrives in a later change; until then track each NDA Status by hand.

Offers are captured on Disposition Offer records against this Disposition. Log the buyer name, offer amount, financing type, due-diligence and closing periods, then work the counter fields until an offer is accepted.

LOI is a phase of this disposition, not a separate record - the disposition-side LOI record arrives in a later change. Until then the negotiation stays on the Disposition Offer record: drive it through Offer Status and the DPEG Counter Price, DPEG Counter Date, Buyer Counter Price and Final Agreed Price fields.

PSA is a phase of this disposition, not a separate record - the disposition-side contract has no record yet and arrives in a later change. PSA Executed on this Disposition is the only marker; tick it on the Closing step once the purchase and sale agreement is signed.

PSA Executed = TRUE spawns closing tasks. Wire fraud prevention gate (6 fields) must be complete before wiring. Complete the wire verification BEFORE submitting the Closing approval - the approval locks this Disposition, so a Wire saved while it is pending will not update the Wire Verification Completed flag until the approval resolves.
Deal closed. Confirm the closing date, net sale proceeds, and that the closing statement is on file.
